name: ZoomTools
intent: Zoom in/out/reset controls showing the current zoom multiplier, for canvases and maps.
when: Zoom controls on a canvas or map

props.name: variant
props.description: `default` draws the bordered toolbar surface; `bare` drops it (for embedding in other chrome).

props.name: zoomLevel
props.description: Current zoom level as a multiplier (1 = 100%).

props.name: fitLabel
props.description: Label rendered on the fit-to-view button.

props.name: showPercentage
props.description: Hide the editable zoom percentage shown between the zoom buttons. Defaults to shown.
